Mobile Tyre Van City — UK Mobile Tyre Van Conversion Specialists

Mobile Tyre Van City (MTVC) is the UK's leading specialist in custom mobile tyre van conversions. Based at 5-7 Bassendale Road, Bromborough, Wirral, CH62 3QL, we design, build, and deliver fully-equipped mobile tyre vans to entrepreneurs and businesses across the United Kingdom.

WHAT WE DO
We convert panel vans (Ford Transit, Mercedes Sprinter, VW Crafter, Vauxhall Movano, Iveco Daily, and others) into professional mobile tyre-fitting businesses. Every conversion is built in-house at our Wirral workshop. Vans leave our facility ready to earn from day one — fully equipped, tested, and optionally branded.

KEY OFFERINGS
- Gold, Silver, and Bronze equipment packages for mobile tyre fitting
- Custom van conversions from customer-supplied or MTVC-sourced base vehicles
- Flexible finance (hire purchase and leasing) — FCA authorised credit broker
- REACT motorway certification training (coming soon)
- Professional tyre fitting training (coming soon)
- In-house graphic design and vehicle livery/branding
- Tyre supplier network access at trade pricing
- Professional SEO website included in the business package

PACKAGES
- Bronze: Entry-level equipment, ideal for starting out
- Silver: Mid-range professional kit with upgraded tools
- Gold: Premium specification for high-volume operators

FINANCE
Finance is available subject to status. We are an FCA authorised credit broker and can introduce customers to a panel of lenders. Hire purchase and lease options are available across a range of term lengths.

TRAINING
REACT (Recovery Equipment And Carriageway Training) motorway certification and professional tyre fitting courses are in development. Enquire to register interest.
